video.topic: Hermes Agent now reads your PDFs and documents 100% locally, without a single API call, using AnyDoc, the open-source PDF analyzer built by the Firecrawl team.

transcript.text: Hermes Agent just dropped another banger for privacy. Now they read your documents locally, meaning that if you need to operate with high confidential documents from either your business or your clients and you run Hermes Agent locally, now you have zero risk of your data actually leaking out. They do this by using AnyDoc, which is an open source PDF analyzer built by the team over at Firecrawl. Now follow for more AI news, videos, and tutorials each and every single day, and catch you in the next one.
